convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for 2pbIdealMA indicator which is a custom indicator, and has complex re-open logic with position management that requires careful handling

other_exits: Re-open logic: closes and re-opens position in same direction when price crosses back to 2pbIdealMA side after moving away, capturing trending moves with fresh SL/TP placement

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Lot input: negative value = fixed lots (absolute value used), positive value = fraction of deposit for margin calculation

custom_logic_notes: The 'ReOpen' feature is the core differentiator: when price moves against the position and then crosses back across the 2pbIdealMA in the favorable direction, the EA closes the existing position and re-opens a new one in the same direction with fresh SL/TP. This effectively resets the trade at a better price during pullback-and-resume scenarios. The 2pbIdealMA is a custom Jurik-style moving average (JMA) with phase and power parameters, accessed via iCustom(). Position sizing has dual mode: negative Lot = fixed lots, positive Lot = deposit fraction for margin-based sizing via OrderCalcMargin(). Previous bar values ([1]) are used for signal generation, not current bar [0].
python_conversion_notes: The 2pbIdealMA custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it is a JMA (Jurik Moving Average) variant with phase/power parameters. The JMA algorithm involves multiple smoothing passes with volatility correction. Consider using the 'ta' library or a custom JMA implementation. The re-open logic requires tracking position state across bars. The dual position sizing mode (fixed vs margin-fraction) needs OrderCalcMargin equivalent. The 5-digit broker adjustment pattern (_Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 multiply SL/TP by 10) must be handled. Signal logic uses previous bar [1] values, so the Python version must use iloc[-2] or equivalent shifted values.
